Compute aliases were added but the legacy /api/mining/* endpoints are kept too — duplicated route surface area without a deprecation header. Recommend tagging the legacy paths with a deprecation warning or a 308 redirect to the canonical /api/compute/* path so clients migrate.

ComputeOrchestrator.jsx still references the legacy '/api/mining/config' string in its UI body — pure-rename without auditing the strings the component renders. Searching for /mining/ literals in /app/frontend/src is recommended as a guard.

Sliding-window fraud detector now correctly avoids single-burst false positives, but the threshold (>12 hb/60s sustained over 2 consecutive samples) is hardcoded — consider lifting to env/config so SRE can tune in production without a redeploy.
RealAndroidDevices.jsx still polls every 5s with no document.hidden pause / no exponential backoff (carried over from iter-7) — admin tabs left open all day will keep hitting the API.

rca of the issue: ComputeOrchestrator.jsx was renamed from MiningOrchestrator.jsx and the surrounding labels were rebranded ('AGGREGATE COMPUTE RATE', 'WORKER-LEVEL COMPUTE RATE'), but the component body still hardcodes the cryptocurrency algorithm names ('SHA-256', 'SCRYPT', 'EQUIHASH', etc.) on the pool selector tiles AND echoes the legacy '/api/mining/config' string in the Pool-Broadcast worker-endpoint card + 'ALGO: SHA-256' in the same card. Single-file fix: in ComputeOrchestrator.jsx (a) replace the algo subtitle with a neutral 'Compute Class · A/B/C' or 'Verified Hash' label (or hide entirely), (b) change the displayed worker endpoint string from '/api/mining/config' to '/api/compute/config', and (c) replace the 'ALGO' label/value in the live broadcast card with 'CLASS' / 'VERIFIED'. No backend change needed — /api/compute/config is already wired as a 1:1 alias of /api/mining/config.
